verifications.independence_basis: Auditor independently read the official NIST abstract and extracted §1.1.1 from the same NISTIR PDF after browser viewer and web PDF-reader failures. §1.1.1 explicitly defines Class A ordinary combustibles as including wood and textiles and states water's primary mechanism is fuel cooling; auditor did not author the candidate commit.
verifications.limits: Conditional Class A mechanism only. NISTIR §1.1.1 defines Class A ordinary combustibles as including wood and textiles, but establishes no actual fire class, fuel state, water amount, apparatus, tactic, safety, success, other fire class, current fire or outcome.
